---
description: "Review the roadmap and plan the next development tasks. Use when starting a new session, planning next steps, or reviewing project progress."
agent: plan
---

Review the GoldenGibbon roadmap and create a prioritized plan for the next tasks.

## Steps

1. Read [roadmap/kanban.md](../roadmap/kanban.md) — identify completed, in-progress, and next tasks
2. Read [roadmap/phase_4.md](../roadmap/phase_4.md) (or the most recent phase file) — detailed tasks for current phase
3. Read [blueprint.md](../blueprint.md) — confirm architectural constraints
4. Identify:
   - What is **done** (checked)
   - What is **in progress** (partially checked or described as started)
   - What is **next** (first unchecked tasks in priority order)
5. Produce a concrete plan with:
   - The 3-5 next tasks to implement
   - Which files will be created or modified for each
   - Any blockers or dependencies between tasks
   - Estimated complexity (small / medium / large)
